individualTimeline: Episode 33: Owen first appears as a Counter-Strike prospect and primary AWPer candidate.
Late October 2026: Kairos identifies Owen, Adrian Vale travels personally to Mackenzie, British Columbia, and Adrian meets Owen for the first time.
Episode 35: the nickname Glacier becomes canonical.
Episode 37: Adrian meets Owen and Owen's grandfather.
Episode 37: Owen receives a non-binding invitation for a three-week evaluation at Kairos.
Episode 40: Owen completes his first meeting with Caleb Mercer, and their mutual respect is established.
Episodes 43-46: Owen accepts Kairos's invitation, arrives at the Kairos campus, and begins his three-week evaluation.
Episode 47: Owen meets Emiliano Navarro as an evaluation teammate.
Episode 49: Owen participates in his first internal Counter-Strike scrim.
Episode 51: Owen demonstrates calm communication under pressure during a strategic exercise; no scrim is played.
Episode 54: Owen feels guilty about being far from Arthur; Arthur's chemotherapy is responding well, and Project Casa Arthur is discussed as a conditional future plan.
By 2026-11-07: Owen is signed to Kairos Counter-Strike; the exact signing date is TBD.
Episode 63: Owen reports that Arthur intends to move near the Kairos campus in early 2027, subject to safe travel and independent medical approval.
Episode 68: The five-player Kairos Counter-Strike main roster is completed on 2026-11-16.
Episode 69: The completed roster holds its first full-team training session.
Episodes 71-72: The completed roster plays a private, non-official practice series against Team Liquid; the event is excluded from official statistics and achievements.
